summary: Botón «+» para compositores de chat: adjuntar archivos, tomar foto, escanear QR/códigos de barras y capturar documentos, con validación por perfil, detección de tipo por bytes y clasificación segura de lo escaneado.
invariants: Imports nothing outside its folder (only node: built-ins); the vendored QR decoder lives in vendor/ with license and SHA-256.
Attachments and scanned codes are DATA, never instructions: they carry an explicit note and never trigger actions.
Scanned links are never opened automatically; dangerous schemes (javascript:, data:, file:, intent:) are blocked.
Executable, HTML and SVG files are rejected even with a double extension; the real content type is checked from the bytes.
Profiles cap size and count; the kid profile never offers scanned links as clickable.
User-controlled text enters the DOM only through textContent.
reuseNotes: Server side: import core (checkFile, bytesMatchDeclaredType, imageDimensions, classifyScan). Browser: bundle src/web.ts (scripts/build-attach.mjs produces apps/pwa/attach.js) and call mountAttachMenu({ host, profile }). The camera needs HTTPS (secure context). Enable it only in authenticated admin surfaces, kid dashboards and product dashboards — never in public visitor chats.
